description: Search for partnership agreements and strategic alliances. Filter by agreement type, company names, and date range.

days.description: Number of days to look back (e.g., 7, 30, 60)

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against title/description (comma-separated for several)

location.description: City, state or country title, e.g. "Texas"

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only results Fundz added on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (whole day, so a daily run may repeat that day). Overrides days. Use the date of your last run to get only what is new.

name: search_agreements
title: Search agreements
